description: Implementation of ShippingService handling shipping configurations, quotes, and modules in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ShippingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing shipping configurations, quotes, and modules in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves shipping configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves specific shipping module configuration by module code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom configuration for a specific shipping module.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates the shipping configuration for a store.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves or updates custom configuration for a shipping module.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Returns available shipping methods for a store.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration for a shipping quote module.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes configuration for a shipping quote module.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes custom configuration for a shipping module.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Retrieves configured shipping modules for a store.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of shipping costs and options.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Calculates shipping quote based on delivery, products, and store settings.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns list of supported countries for shipping.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Provides list of countries to ship to based on configuration.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of supported countries for shipping.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates total order amount from products.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the cart requires shipping.
